sentences.en: We get support from UC Davis, a globally ranked university working to solve the world's most pressing problems in food, energy, health, education, and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们获得了加州大学戴维斯分校的支持，这是一所全球知名的高等学府，致力于解决当今世界在食品、能源、健康、教育和环境领域最紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加州及全球各地开展合作与创新，以寻求变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这完全符合该校促进所有生命生活质量的宗旨。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stcentury.ucdavis.edu.
sentences.zh: 访问 21stcentury.ucdavis.edu 了解更多信息。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是“99%隐形”。

sentences.en: I want you to give your name and where we are.
sentences.zh: 我想请你报上你的名字以及我们现在所在的地方。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: My name is Henrik Bull.
sentences.zh: 我叫亨里克·布尔。

sentences.en: Henrik Bull became president of the San Francisco chapter of the American Institute of Architects in 1968.
sentences.zh: 亨里克·布尔于1968年担任美国建筑师协会旧金山分会会长。

sentences.en: And we're having this conversation at the base of the Transamerica Pyramid.
sentences.zh: 我们现在正在泛美金字塔大厦的底部进行这场对话。

sentences.en: Construction of the Transamerica Pyramid began in 1969.
sentences.zh: 泛美金字塔大厦于1969年开始动工建设。

sentences.en: Looking up into infinity as the building comes to a point 850 feet above us.
sentences.zh: 仰望无垠的天空，大厦在离我们850英尺的高空汇聚成一个尖顶。

sentences.en: This is not the best view of the building.
sentences.zh: 这并不是这座建筑的最佳观赏视角。

sentences.en: In the beginning, Henrik Bull and the Transamerica Pyramid did not get along.
sentences.zh: 最初，亨里克·布尔和泛美金字塔大厦并不对付。

sentences.en: And the San Francisco AIA opposed its construction.
sentences.zh: 美国建筑师协会旧金山分会曾反对它的修建。

sentences.en: Buildings should make sense.
sentences.zh: 建筑应该合乎情理。

sentences.en: There's nothing about this building that makes sense.
sentences.zh: 而这座建筑身上没有任何地方是合乎情理的。

sentences.en: It was sort of a silly design dunce cap.
sentences.zh: 它就像是一个愚蠢的设计笨蛋帽。

sentences.en: We thought that the pyramid shape was just nothing but a, let's call it advertising symbol.
sentences.zh: 我们认为金字塔形状不过是一个——我们称之为广告符号的东西。

sentences.en: The top third of it is just plain air.
sentences.zh: 它的顶端三分之一根本就是虚空。

sentences.en: In the era of modern architecture, building a couple of hundred feet of symbol was just not considered proper or even moral.
sentences.zh: 在现代主义建筑盛行的时代，建造几百英尺高的纯粹符号被认为是不合时宜的，甚至是缺乏道德的。

sentences.en: In an article in late 2009, San Francisco Chronicle urban design writer John King summarized several of the contemporary criticisms of the Transamerica Pyramid's proposed design.
sentences.zh: 在2009年底的一篇文章中，《旧金山纪事报》城市设计撰稿人约翰·金总结了当时对泛美金字塔拟议设计的几项批评。

sentences.en: Putting it in San Francisco would be no less reprehensible than destroying the Grand Canyon, an inhuman creation, a second-class World's Fair space needle.
sentences.zh: 把它放在旧金山，其罪过不亚于毁掉大峡谷，这是一个非人性的创造，一个二流的世界博览会太空针塔。

sentences.en: Then-Assemblyman John Burton said the pyramid would rape the skyline.
sentences.zh: 时任州议员约翰·伯顿曾说，这座金字塔将强奸天际线。

sentences.en: Jeez.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Oh my god.
sentences.zh: 我的天啊。

sentences.en: It seemed to violate the whole purpose of zoning and urban planning.
sentences.zh: 它似乎违背了土地区划和城市规划的整体宗旨。

sentences.en: The surrounding buildings were no more than three stories tall.
sentences.zh: 周围的建筑最高也不过三层。

sentences.en: This was definitely not the vision of that neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 这绝对不是那个街区所设想的愿景。

sentences.en: But over the course of 40 years, something happened.
sentences.zh: 但在40年的时间里，情况发生了变化。

sentences.en: Some people have never lost their hatred for the Transamerica Pyramid.
sentences.zh: 有些人从未停止过对泛美金字塔的厌恶。

sentences.en: But others, like Henrik Bull and the AIA San Francisco, who recently voted at one of the top commercial buildings in the city, have done a complete 180.
sentences.zh: 但另一些人，比如亨里克·布尔和美国建筑师协会旧金山分会——他们最近刚把它评选为该市顶商业建筑之一——却来了一个180度的大转弯。

sentences.en: And it all seems to depend on where you're standing.
sentences.zh: 这一切似乎都取决于你站的位置。

sentences.en: You could almost say the further you get away from it, the better it looks.
sentences.zh: 你甚至可以说，你离它越远，它看起来就越好看。

sentences.en: But, you know, that'd be sort of nasty.
sentences.zh: 不过，你知道，这话未免有点刻薄。

sentences.en: It's only a little nasty.
sentences.zh: 其实也就稍微有点刻薄。

sentences.en: And funny.
sentences.zh: 而且很有趣。

sentences.en: And true.
sentences.zh: 并且还是事实。

sentences.en: When the building was completed, many of us who had a post-it realized that, you know, this is sort of a neat building on the skyline.
sentences.zh: 当这座建筑完工时，我们这些曾经贴过便签反对的人意识到，你知道，在天际线上这其实是一座挺不错的建筑。

sentences.en: Especially as a silhouette when the sun's going down.
sentences.zh: 特别是当夕阳西下时，它的剪影。

sentences.en: It's really quite graceful.
sentences.zh: 确实相当优雅。

sentences.en: The taller buildings since really are pretty dull.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，后来那些更高的建筑其实相当无趣。

sentences.en: And this, God knows, wasn't dull.
sentences.zh: 而这座建筑，天知道，它可一点也不无趣。

sentences.en: I don't remember any discussion of what it's going to look like looking down Columbus Avenue.
sentences.zh: 我不记得当时有没有人讨论过顺着哥伦布大道看过去会是什么风景。

sentences.en: Columbus Avenue is a diagonal street and a broad street.
sentences.zh: 哥伦布大道是一条对角线街道，也是一条宽阔的街道。

sentences.en: The Transamerica building is right at the end.
sentences.zh: 泛美大厦就正好位于尽头。

sentences.en: I don't know if you know the term vanishing point in perspective.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你是否知道透视学中的“消失点”这个词。

sentences.en: Everything goes and diagonals to a point.
sentences.zh: 所有的东西都沿着对角线汇聚到一个点。

sentences.en: And in a way, you tilt that vanishing point up vertically and there's the Transamerica building.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，你把那个消失点垂直向上倾斜，泛美大厦就在那里。

sentences.en: It just is a big surprise.
sentences.zh: 它真是一个巨大的惊喜。

sentences.en: And had that been a conventional modern building of the time, it would have been a tragedy, really.
sentences.zh: 如果当时建的是一座符合时代常规的现代建筑，那才真是一场悲剧。

sentences.en: I would say it's one of my favorite buildings.
sentences.zh: 我会说这是我最喜欢的建筑之一。

sentences.en: Not close up.
sentences.zh: 不是近看。

sentences.en: How it meets the ground, I don't think ever really got solved.
sentences.zh: 它与地面的交接处理，我觉得从来没有真正解决好过。

sentences.en: The triangle shapes and the columns are awkward.
sentences.zh: 三角形的形状和那些柱子显得很别扭。

sentences.en: And if you look up at the building from below, the spacing of the windows has to be pretty weird to accommodate that pyramid shape.
sentences.zh: 如果你从下方抬头看这座建筑，为了配合金字塔的形状，窗户的间距不得不安排得非常诡异。

sentences.en: But still.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此。

sentences.en: So a complete 180.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个180度的大转弯。

sentences.en: I think that's really impressive.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这真的很令人佩服。

sentences.en: I think that shows strength of character on your part.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这展现了你的性格力量。

sentences.en: Well, I had that same conversation with John King.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我和约翰·金也聊过同样的话题。

sentences.en: That's the aforementioned San Francisco Chronicle, Architecture Critic, whose article on this you should really go read.
sentences.zh: 也就是前面提到的《旧金山纪事报》建筑评论家，你们真的应该去读读他关于这篇建筑的文章。

sentences.en: He was quite surprised when I said that we didn't understand the problem and we were wrong.
sentences.zh: 当我承认我们当时没搞懂问题而且我们错了时，他非常惊讶。

sentences.en: And he said, gosh, I don't think I remember an architect saying that before.
sentences.zh: 他说，天哪，我不记得以前有哪个建筑师会这么说。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible is produced by me, Roman Mars, with support from Lunar.
sentences.zh: “99%隐形”由我罗曼·马尔斯制作，并得到了Lunar公司的支持。

sentences.en: It's a project of KALW, the American Institute of Architects San Francisco, and the Center for Architecture and Design.
sentences.zh: 这是KALW、美国建筑师协会旧金山分会以及建筑与设计中心的合作项目。

sentences.en: Find out more at 99percentinvisible.org.
sentences.zh: 访问 99percentinvisible.org 了解更多信息。
